0x000988.en: 「At my level now...@　this is as far as I go...!」

0x000A81.en: 「Damn it!@　Next time you won't get me!」

0x000BAA.en: 「Is this as far as I get......!?」

0x000BE2.en: 「Oh dear...@　how uncool of me, honestly!」

0x000CAB.en: 「Hngh! So this is where it ends...!」

0x000CE6.en: 「No way I screw up here...!@　This isn't fun...」

0x000D3A.en: 「I blew it...!@　Nothing to do but bail out...」

0x000DAE.en: 「Guh! Nothing for it but to fall back!!」

0x000E24.en: 「This is as far as I go......!」

0x000E8B.en: 「This is the end for me... the rest is yours.」

0x000EF9.en: 「Grrgh! So they got the jump on me......」

0x000F37.en: 「No good, took too much damage... I'm pulling out!」

0x000F84.en: 「This is a mess. I leave the rest to you.」

0x000FC2.en: 「Aah! I'll leave the rest to all of you!」

0x001009.en: 「To think the Granzon... would be shot down...」

0x0010B4.en: 「Ngh... me, a shooting star? ...I'm bailing out!」

0x001133.en: 「I-I can't take any more of this...!」

0x00116B.en: 「Ow ow ow... you got me. A miscalculation on my part.」

0x0011F0.en: 「Ngh... urgh! Is this as far as I go...!」

0x00125D.en: 「Tch! All hands, abandon ship at once!!」

0x0012A4.en: 「I'm sorry. I leave the rest to you.」

0x0012D9.en: 「Damn it! Is this the limit of my strength...!」

0x00131D.en: 「Any more and I'm done for! Retreating!」

0x0013C5.en: 「To be beaten in a place like this...@ how green of me...!」

0x001413.en: 「No good, I can't hold on! Retreating!」

0x0014CE.en: 「Sorry, I leave the rest to you!」

0x0014FD.en: 「N-no good! This is as far as I go!!」

0x00153B.en: 「Well well, so this is where it ends.」

0x00156A.en: 「I can't go on any further. I'll take my leave.」

0x0015F5.en: 「Was I careless...@ I'll pull back for now...!」

0x001672.en: 「Tch...! I can't hold out after all...!」

0x00175B.en: 「Ejecting...@ ngh...! Not very graceful, is it...」

0x001819.en: 「Guhh! Not in a place like this!!」

0x001A2B.en: 「No good, they went and got me.」

0x001ABD.en: 「Grrr, to think that Shu Shirakawa@ had saved Roff...!@ That man, forever getting in my way...!」

0x001B59.en: 「In that case,@ I shall settle everything with my own hands!@ Come, apes! And you traitors as well!」

0x001BF5.en: 「You're cornered, Zezernan.@ If you're willing to surrender, I'll accept it.」

0x001C63.en: 「Foolishness. This situation is an opportunity for me.」

0x001CC6.en: 「Defeat you here and the rest are just a rabble.@ Once the Privy Council learns Earth's true state,@ they'll hesitate to commit more forces.」

0x001D9F.en: 「Your premise is flawed.@ You think you can actually defeat us?」

0x001E04.en: 「Heh... I'm here precisely because victory is within reach.」

0x001E4A.en: 「What's with that geezer... cornered this badly,@ yet so full of himself.」

0x001F17.en: 「A super-heavy mobile weapon developed to fight@ specialized forces, in other words, the likes of you...」

0x001FA3.en: 「It surpasses the Dikastes that Wendro@ once piloted, and a single unit can@ dominate a wide combat zone.」

0x002042.en: 「Thaat's Zezernan's truump card. It can eeven@ snipe Earth's cities from riight heeere.」

0x002107.en: 「If it's a super-heavy weapon,@ it's gotta be like fifty kilometers long, right?」

0x0021B2.en: 「I dunno if it's a Zul or a Bora,@ but if it's tougher than the Dark Brain,@ I'll gawk with my eyes wide open.」

0x00223F.en: 「On the way here we fought guys from other worlds,@ hermit sages, monsters, the works.@ A half-baked machine won't surprise us.」

0x0022E1.en: 「If it's a cool machine, you'll take a picture, right?」

0x002371.en: (He's so relaxed... maybe we've been up against far@ more absurd people than we ever realized...)

0x0023F7.en: 「That fighting spirit, bordering on reckless valor...@ Just as I thought, you Earth apes are dangerous.」

0x002496.en: 「You call us apes, but we look the same.@ You criticize Earth's political systems,@ yet what you do in your homeland is no different.」

0x002544.en: 「When I once traveled to Earth,@ I studied its history...」

0x00259A.en: 「I'm astonished that such a foolish species@　still survives in this galaxy.」

0x0025FF.en: 「Did you know? You've driven thousands,@　tens of thousands of species to extinction@　in such a short span of time.」

0x002699.en: 「Under our Species Preservation Act, that means life imprisonment. Self-rule for such lowly creatures? Never.」

0x002741.en: 「We're in no place to talk down to you.@ On the road to building the Interstellar Federation,@ we drove countless species to extinction too.」

0x0027D7.en: 「It's only a matter of time.@　You push other species toward ruin@　at a pace we can't even come close to matching.」

0x002855.en: 「And you keep slaughtering your own kind.@ Unlike us, you don't use combat bioroids,@ you wage endless wars of bloodshed.」

0x00290F.en: 「Our world had such an age too.@ And even now, when non-humans are the ones standing on the battlefield,@ war itself hasn't disappeared.」

0x0029DB.en: 「But you know full well the Earth apes' combat instinct@ runs far stronger than ours.」

0x002A58.en: 「And their knack for applying military technology@ exceeded even our predictions.」

0x002AC0.en: 「You Earth apes don't have a proper balance of intellect and power.@ Should such creatures advance into our world,@ they will surely throw our order into chaos.」

0x002B6B.en: 「We're not reaching for the sea of stars@ in order to make war!」

0x002BCD.en: 「Can you swear every ape is like that?@ You yourselves bear arms@ and have gathered here, have you not?」

0x002C5A.en: 「What are you talking about!@ You're the ones who attacked us one-sidedly,@ that's why it came to this!」

0x002CF0.en: 「I never meant a war of invasion. I planned to proceed through negotiation. It was you, Shu Shirakawa, who obstructed that.」

0x002DCE.en: 「...had it been talks between equals,@ there'd have been room to avoid that affair@ at the South Pole and choose another way.」

0x002E73.en: 「Negotiating on equal footing@ with barbarians like you is unthinkable.」

0x002ECF.en: 「That's your prejudice, Zezernan.@ Earthlings can talk with us as equals.@ Through all these battles, I've come to understand that.」

0x002F80.en: 「Foolish... swayed by a lesser species, are you.@ Then you share their guilt.」

0x003023.en: 「You line up all sorts of noble pretexts,@ but your true aim is to monopolize Earth's interests.」

0x003097.en: 「And you deceived us, used us,@ and in the end tried to cut us loose.」

0x0030FC.en: 「Until now I obeyed because those were orders...@ but I've no reason or obligation to listen to you anymore.」

0x00317C.en: 「That's right... I'm through fighting@ for your greed.」

0x0031CF.en: 「Setti, Zeb... forgetting the favor I showed you!」

0x00321E.en: 「Look who's talking. The moment things went sour@ you'd have cut us loose too.@ I never once felt I owed you anything.」

0x00331C.en: 「When Zeb gets seriously angry, he gets like that sometimes.」

0x003366.en: 「Then what's his usual way of talking?@ An act? A gimmick to stand out? Or a bit?@ For an alien to do that, what's the deal?」

0x00342C.en: 「Why don't you follow his usual example@ and try talking more slowly...?」

0x0034A0.en: 「No thanks. I'd overlap with a certain someone.@ Besides, talking that leisurely@ is simply beyond me. Right, Master?」

0x00358E.en: 「...I didn't expect otherwise, but...@ a fight with Zezernan is unavoidable after all.@ Sorry about this, Commander Lefina.」

0x003633.en: 「No... thanks to hearing your thoughts,@ I believe we've found a real chance@ for cooperation between us and the Zovok.」

0x0036D8.en: 「Zezernan's words hold some truth,@ and as an Earthling they did sting, that's true...@ but we can't leave him unchecked.」

0x003783.en: 「Prattle on, ape. This lunar surface@ shall become your grave.」

0x0037D9.en: 「I'll return those words to you.@ You're the one who'll fall here with your ambition.@ The moon is quiet, you can sleep soundly.」

0x00386C.en: 「All units, the target is Zezernan! Commence attack!」

0x0038A9.en: 「Zezernan,@ your ambition will never be fulfilled!」

0x0038F6.en: 「Hmph, I'll not be bested by you,@ a puppet of the Privy Council.」

0x00394F.en: 「The nerve, forgetting your place as a mercenary and turning your blade on me.」

0x003998.en: 「I'm out of the mercenary business...!@ But first, I'll settle things with you!」

0x003A4D.en: 「Insolent fool... who do you think I am!」

0x003A93.en: 「Having sided with me then defied me,@ you'll have no place left in the homeland either.」

0x003AF2.en: 「Better than staying aboard a sinking ship.」

0x003B2C.en: 「I've been waiting for this moment.@ For you to be cornered, struggling@ as you go to your ruin.」

0x003BAA.en: 「Curse you, Shu Shirakawa...!@ It's you, if only you weren't here, my plan would...!」

0x003C1E.en: 「Yes... regret it. Regret having used me.@ And then, die.」

0x003C80.en: 「You lowly creatures...!@ Standing as equals with you is unthinkable.」

0x003CE5.en: 「That prejudice@ is what will destroy you!」

0x003D32.en: 「A battleship like that won't stop us!@　Now quit stalling and bring out that@　Baran Schnail of yours!」

0x003DB6.en: 「Hmph. The lowly ape is getting cocky.」

0x003DF0.en: 「Nothing good ever comes of Shu getting involved...@　Not knowing that is what sealed your fate!」

0x003E6D.en: 「Then I'll destroy you along with him, and@　claim both the Granzon and the Machine God.」

0x003ED8.en: 「Heh, neither one's a toy@　the likes of you could ever handle!」

0x003F4D.en: 「No, not yet!@　The Baran Schnail is coming out!」

0x003F9D.en: 「Hmhmhm... So you'd force me to use this...」

0x003FDD.en: 「This Baran Schnail was developed@　with foes exactly like you in mind...」

0x004057.en: 「With this, I can wipe out the swarming apes...@　and seize dominion over the Earth itself.」

0x0040D1.en: 「Dominion over Earth with a single unit...?@　That's raving madness.」

0x00412D.en: 「It's big, sure, but nothing to gawk at.」

0x004167.en: 「That thing was deployed in place of the@　super-heavy gunship we were meant to bring.」

0x0041ED.en: 「Firepower to rival a gunship, and mobility@ beyond the Geios series. A fearsome machine.」

0x00426A.en: 「If anything, you'd be more shocked@　seeing that super-heavy gunship.」

0x0042C6.en: 「Don't let your guard down.@　If it can snipe the Earth from here,@　its effective range speaks for itself.」

0x004356.en: 「Lucky or not, Baral's barrier likely blocks surface attacks... but if Zezernan means it, a lunar city could vanish.」

0x00442F.en: 「Then we just beat him down fast.@ We've fought through hells@ like this plenty of times before. And we'll do it again.」

0x0044DD.en: 「There's at least two more hells to come, I'd wager.」

0x004523.en: 「...Dr. Shirakawa,@　that trick you used in the last Moon Cradle battle?」

0x004582.en: 「Ah, the one that broke through the gravity@　field I set up. What about it?」

0x0045E7.en: 「I can use it, but it limits which units can move.@　And after Zezernan boasted like that, he's surely@　prepared some countermeasure of his own.」

0x0046B9.en: 「Then we've got no choice but to do it straight.」

0x004724.en: 「Come, then.@　I'll grant you apes the miserable death@　that befits your kind.」

0x004799.en: 「You still don't see that your contempt@　is what will corner you.」

0x0047EF.en: 「Big talk from an ape good for nothing but fighting.」

0x004826.en: 「Enough with 'ape, ape, ape'!@　If you love monkeys so much, go visit a zoo!」

0x0048A9.en: 「Does telling an alien to visit a zoo even land, y'know?」

0x004917.en: 「Hey!@　This is no time to be bickering!」

0x004970.en: 「To trade quips before the Baran Schnail...@　Truly, you are fools to the core.」

0x0049DE.en: 「You'd do well not to underestimate them.@　After all, I've tasted defeat at their hands too.」

0x004A4C.en: 「Hmph. You and I are nothing alike.」

0x004A71.en: 「Is that so.@　Then let us sever this long grudge@　between us once and for all.」

0x004AE6.en: 「And you shall savor the ultimate humiliation.@　Defeat at the hands of those you scorn@　as lesser beings... that shame.」

0x004B88.en: 「What I shall savor is victory and glory!@　No matter how many apes like you gather,@　the Baran Schnail cannot be felled!」

0x004C21.en: 「Then we'll make you howl!@　Howl just like a monkey!」

0x004C7D.en: 「All units, commence attack! Bring down Zezernan@　and end this war with the Gest here and now!」

0x004D00.en: 「Zezernan...@　The moment you rolled out that Baran Schnail,@　you as good as admitted defeat, y'know?」

0x004D9C.en: 「Hmph. Victory and defeat are never certain until the end.@　Though losing to you, tainted by the apes,@　is simply not possible.」

0x004E47.en: 「That confidence... it's gone past appalling@　clear into impressive.」

0x004E8A.en: 「The Zeidram cannot fell the Baran Schnail.@　Die regretting that you ever@　dared to oppose me.」

0x004F23.en: 「What I regret is ever having sided with you.@　I doubt this battle can settle all of it, but...」

0x004FB2.en: 「I'll give it everything and cut you down!@　Otherwise, I can't move forward!」

0x005014.en: 「A subordinate's mess is for the commanding officer to clean up.」

0x00505A.en: 「That's my line!@　Not by Earthling hands, but by a Zovok's,@　I'll bring you down!」

0x0050E1.en: 「Well, well... Never thought I'd end up@　fighting the Baran Schnail.」

0x00513A.en: 「Too late for regrets now. I'll pass the sentence of death.」

0x00517A.en: 「Aren't you the one with regrets?@　You can't turn this situation around anymore.」

0x0051DF.en: 「Granzon or not,@　it's no match for this Baran Schnail.」

0x005241.en: 「If I used only the technology the Gest provided,@　perhaps that would be true...」

0x0052B2.en: 「But my Granzon holds a power@　beyond anything you can imagine.」

0x005317.en: 「Though it seems I won't need@　to show it to you. Heh heh heh.」

0x005376.en: 「Well now, this is the finale, Zezernan.@　Trotting that thing out won't win you a thing.」

0x0053FC.en: 「Hmph... Pitiful, one who knows not his own strength.」

0x005436.en: 「I'll throw those exact words right back at you!」

0x00546D.en: 「The technology in that machine@　did not originate with us.」

0x0054C3.en: 「I know that much - the Aerogaters@　aren't the same as you lot!」

0x005525.en: 「Then do you understand@　just what their true nature is?」

0x0055B6.en: 「I have not given up yet.@　The Cybuster... I will make its technology mine.」

0x00561B.en: 「You don't understand the first thing about a Masou Kishin.@ You can build something like it, but never the real thing!」

0x0056B3.en: 「Show me whether that machine's got the power@　to back up all that big talk!」

0x00571B.en: 「Hmph, little monkey... regret won't be the end of it.」

0x00575E.en: 「I'll soar across the galaxy!@　Past you... past everything!」

0x0057C0.en: 「Who would ever permit you apes to spread!@　I'll pluck the seed of calamity here and now!」

0x005822.en: 「A creature of prejudice like you@　can't stop my brother's dream, or ours!」

0x00588A.en: 「An ape speaking of dreams! Don't make me laugh!」

0x0058BE.en: 「You keep calling us apes, but y'know,@　stick 'planet' or 'legion' on it and it's no joke.」

0x00594B.en: 「And for the record, I'm the chimpanzee kind, thanks!」

0x005997.en: 「I said, what are you talking about!?」

0x0059BF.en: 「I-Impossible! To such lowly creatures!@　To mere apes! Why!?」

0x005A21.en: 「I'm latching onto the Baran Schnail!@　Clear me a path!」

0x005AB9.en: 「Truth is, my orders were to keep Zezernan@　alive if at all possible even in combat@　and take him in.」

0x005B59.en: 「To press him on his other crimes and get at the truth.@　Besides, if he dies here, more facts@　get buried in the dark.」

0x005BF8.en: 「Accept the pity of apes...!?@　I've no wish to live in disgrace like you...!!」

0x005C66.en: 「Don't be a fool!@　You're going to answer for all of it, properly!」

0x005CED.en: 「Th-This guy! A self-destruct device!?@　Everyone, get clear of him!」

0x005D43.en: 「R-Remember this, Mekibos!@　You and the Privy Council both - the day will come@　when you regret thwarting my plan!!」

0x005DF8.en: 「Hear me, Earth is beyond doubt the galaxy's tumor!@　Look at that world now! Devoured by inhuman things!」

0x005E84.en: 「It is not the apes alone!@　The calamity born of Earth@　will surely engulf the entire galaxy!!」

0x005EFC.en: 「That world is cursed! It is the source of disaster!@　The day will come when you regret it! It surely will!!」

0x005F88.en: 「In time, you too will walk the same fate as I!!@　Regret it! Regret it!! Regret it alllll...!!」

0x006030.en: （Damn it, he took the dark heart of his plan@　with him to the grave...）

0x006089.en: （Was it his pride he was protecting, or was he, even now,@　worried about where Zogal would end up...）

0x0060FD.en: （Either way, I'll grant him this much -@　his final moment, at least, was clean...）

0x0061B2.en: 「Not the outcome I wanted, but...@　if it only means the war with the Earth forces@　is ended, I'll take it.」

0x006224.en: 「No, we're still here. Having fought@　as commanders, we have a duty@　to answer for it.」

0x0062A2.en: 「With Zezernan dead, I'll bear@　the full responsibility for everything.」

0x00630E.en: 「So I ask that the others not be charged.@　Promise me that, and I'll gladly offer up my head.」

0x0063D2.en: 「Roff-chan's a mercenary, y'kno~ow.@　The heaviest responsibility falls on me~e.」

0x006434.en: 「If we're talking about that, then I...」

0x006465.en: 「You'll all be placed in my custody for now,@　and handed to the Privy Council once we're back home.」

0x0064E2.en: 「Steel yourselves for a hard interrogation.@　What happens after is for the higher-ups to decide.@　Of course, I mean to put in a word for you.」

0x0065A2.en: 「But the Earth forces won't let it end there.」

0x0065D6.en: 「I'll handle that. You withdraw@　your remaining forces and@　rendezvous with my fleet.」

0x006657.en: 「Scrap any units or bioroids you can't recover.@　They'll become Earth spoils, but so be it.@　I want to avoid any more fighting.」

0x00671A.en: 「That won't quite settle it, will it no~ow?」

0x006754.en: 「Earth being in the state it's in...@　they've no room to give chase right now.」

0x0067C2.en: 「Fair enou~ough, but what're@　you planning to do, Meki-cha~an?」

0x006818.en: 「I'm off to the Steel Dragon Squadron to plead my case.@　To ease the bad blood between us, even a little.」

0x00688C.en: 「Anyway, join the fleet and await my orders.@　See you around.」

0x0068F1.en: 「...Well the~en, better close up shop quick.」

0x006973.en: 「...Um... if we make it home safely...@　then, if maybe...」

0x006A01.en: 「I don't know my sentence back home, but... once I've atoned and if I'm still alive... I'll leave the mercenary life behind.」

0x006AB8.en: 「I probably can't even go home again...@ Even so, Setti... will you come with me?」

0x006B32.en: 「O-Of course, Roff...@　Wherever you go, anywhere at all...」

0x006B97.en: 「I'm a man good for nothing but fighting, but...@　if that's all right with you... then, um... marry-」

0x006C0B.en: 「Roff... I...@　I've been waiting for those words all this time...」

0x006C5B.en: （Oh de~ear, I'm one heck of a third whee~el.）

0x006CEF.en: 「...Selevis has been freed too.@　We're all safe here, staff included.@　My thanks to the Steel Dragon Squadron.」

0x006DA4.en: 「The Inspectors? To think those who once@　raided this place would aid in liberating@　the Moon... I didn't see that coming.」

0x006E31.en: 「I can't go into detail, but it seems@　they've got their own circumstances.」

0x006E93.en: 「What do you all intend to do from here?」

0x006ED3.en: 「Let's see... Storm the Garden of Baral,@ or descend to Earth. We're about to talk it over.」

0x006F53.en: 「Either way, you're bound for@　a dangerous mission, that much is certain...」

0x006FD7.en: 「Of course I am.@　I'd like to help, but as things stand...」

0x007027.en: 「...I found a nice place in Tokyo.」

0x00706B.en: 「I'm going to go make a reservation.@　So do me a favor and keep your schedule open.」

0x007104.en: 「Right. Pick out a dress and wait for me.@　Well, I'll cut the line here.」

0x007169.en: 「Wait, Irm. About the director and the staff...」

0x0071A9.en: 「I know. And the Exexbein we've staked@　the company's future on, of course.」

0x00722D.en: 「The rest can wait until we're watching@　the Tokyo night skyline. See you.」

0x00735C.en: 「The Privy Council wants to know what's happening on Earth.@　Gathering intel is the official reason.」

0x0073FE.en: 「My own curiosity... and to serve as your hostage.」

0x00745D.en: 「I'll place myself in your hands.@　In exchange, so to speak, I won't hand Zeb and@　the others over to you as prisoners.」

0x007524.en: 「They'll wait quietly until this is over.@　They've no desire for more trouble either.」

0x00759E.en: 「And if the situation in the Earth sphere@　worsens further, I'll lend you my fleet as well.@　If you want it, that is.」

0x007665.en: 「For now, the plan is to withdraw back home.」

0x0076AB.en: 「You say that, but aren't you just@　going to send an army in again?」

0x007716.en: 「We've no intention of taking you on.@　That's exactly why I came to stop Zezernan.」

0x007796.en: 「Of course, you won't take me at my word so easily...@　which is why I'll place myself in your hands.」

0x007820.en: 「If possible, for the sake of the Privy Council's@　goodwill, I'd hope for decent treatment.」

0x007897.en: 「Tch, nothing but convenient talk out of you.」

0x0078F6.en: 「So, how shall we proceed, Captain?@　The Zovok intel he holds@　is hard to come by.」

0x007983.en: 「...I can't get the higher-ups' judgment right now... and to minimize trouble, I'll handle this on my own authority.」

0x007A65.en: 「Mekibos Volkuede.@　Your person will remain in our custody.」

0x007AD3.en: 「That's a help.@　There are plenty of familiar faces here, after all.」

0x007B2F.en: 「Though there'll be considerable restrictions on your movements.」

0x007B72.en: 「Of course.@ If you like, you're welcome to count my Graterkin@ among your forces.」

0x007C00.en: 「I told you I had my own interest in this.@　I want to see these Ruina and Baral for myself,@　up close.」

0x007CBB.en: 「It's the captain's order, so I've no choice, but......@　if you try anything funny, a mere thrashing@　won't be the end of it.」

0x007D6D.en: 「Now, on to the next item.@　......Dr. Shirakawa.」

0x007DBD.en: 「Regarding Baral's barrier......@　we've found a promising way to break through it.」

0x007E50.en: 「Yes.@　As you already know, there's exactly one spot on Earth@　not covered by Baral's barrier.」

0x007EF0.en: 「Correct.@　The skies above Fabula Foris remain@　shrouded by Ruina's barrier......」

0x007F6E.en: 「And even Baral's barrier, it seems,@　cannot encroach upon that space.」

0x007FD0.en: 「But isn't Ruina's barrier just as impenetrable?」

0x008019.en: 「It is, however......@　between Baral's and Ruina's barriers, there exists@　a boundary of mutual non-interference.」

0x0080A9.en: 「And if we pry that boundary open and slide down@　along the surface of the barrier......@　a descent to the South Pole may be possible.」

0x00813C.en: 「And how do we pry this boundary open?」

0x008183.en: 「The key lies with the Altairlion and the Vegalion.」

0x0081C9.en: 「Both machines carry third-generation Tesla Drives,@　enabling synchronized operation of two drives,@　known as Twin Modal.」

0x008280.en: 「Simply put, each unit senses the other's <Tesla Drive> in space, so even if it triggers a spatial interference severe enough to collapse its own stability......」

0x008360.en: 「its partner locally neutralizes the effect within its own domain.」

0x0083AC.en: 「And when the Altairlion and Vegalion combine@　into the Hyperion and push the Tesla Drive output@　to its absolute maximum......」

0x008466.en: 「Twin Modal becomes Quad Modal, and a perfect sphere@　called a Discrete Sphere forms around the unit.」

0x008514.en: 「This sphere becomes a perfect mirror, its interior theorized to be a space discontinuous from the universe outside.」

0x0085F0.en: 「Given the right conditions, the Hyperion can release its limiter, manifest Quad Modal, and generate a powerful barrier.」

0x0086B9.en: 「Major Filio said it might even be able to tear@　the space-time continuum itself, but......@　at this stage, that's a distant dream.」

0x00877C.en: 「I'm starting to get it.@　Basically we jam the Hyperion's Discrete Sphere@　into the gap between the barriers like a wedge?」

0x00881B.en: 「Yes.@　It's an extremely high-risk method, but......」

0x00886B.en: 「So if we charge in and it doesn't work,@　we all go down together, huh.」

0x0088C7.en: 「I'll be your insurance. With my Granzon.」

0x008923.en: 「First, we secure acceleration space toward the descent point, then the Hyperion, Granzon, and Hiryu Kai move out in that order.」

0x0089D1.en: 「While accelerating, just before hitting the boundary,@　the Hyperion deploys its Discrete Sphere@　and pries the hole open.」

0x008A67.en: 「Then the Granzon uses its <Distortion Field>@　to disperse the various shockwaves from friction@　while widening the opened hole further.」

0x008B11.en: 「Finally, the Hiryu Kai charges in with Break Field deployed, slides down Ruina's barrier, decelerates, and lands on the ice.」

0x008BFF.en: 「Not high, by any means, but......@　far better than storming Baral's Garden@　head-on.」

0x008C80.en: 「You're not playing us false, are you, Shu?」

0x008CAE.en: 「Of course not. I'm putting my own life on the line too.」

0x008CEE.en: 「Another concern: we could come under attack@　from Baral before the descent, and from Ruina@　after it.」

0x008D7B.en: 「That...... we'll just have to handle it ourselves.」

0x008DD7.en: 「Yes...... To face what's coming, we must@ reclaim our true strength. We'll adopt@ Dr. Shirakawa and Chief Takakura's plan......」

0x008EA0.en: 「This ship returns to Earth.@　Relay the operation to all hands and begin preparations.」

0x008F77.en: 「......So we made it this far without incident.」

0x008FB1.en: 「I thought Baral's forces would show up@　like last time, but......」

0x009010.en: 「They have to be aware of us. Is there some reason@　they're not making a move......?」

0x009087.en: 「No point worrying about that now.@　We just focus on manifesting the@　Discrete Sphere.」

0x009132.en: 「Right. The course and timing are all on you.@　Stay sharp.」

0x0091A0.en: 「I know.@　Everyone's lives...... just for a moment, they're in my hands.」

0x00924C.en: （I'll do it...... I'll make this work, no matter what......!）

0x009351.en: 「10 seconds to the boundary!@　Hold this course!」

0x0094A1.en: 「W-we did it! We did it!@　We slipped through the barrier!!」

0x009547.en: 「So Ruina was lying in wait after all.」

0x0095BC.en: 「Multiple high-speed objects closing in!@　Straight ahead, dead on!」

0x009665.en: 「The Custos are withdrawing from the battle zone!」

0x0096F5.en: 「But why......? The fish-type Custos@　attacked us before......」

0x009766.en: 「Captain, message from Steel 2!@　They appear to be off the Ross Sea!」

0x0097D2.en: 「This is a stroke of luck.@　Could they be taking part in@　Operation Icebreaker?」

0x009862.en: 「Perhaps.@　This ship will withdraw from the current airspace@　at once and rendezvous with the Hagane.」
